span.p:
viewport meta width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover
NO maximum-scale, NO user-scalable=no, pinch zoom preserved
-webkit-text-size-adjust 100% stops Safari inflating text
sticky footer CTA, safe-area-inset-bottom
brand header padded by safe-area-inset-top
MEASURED after close, scale 1, offsets 0 0, no permanent pan

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p:
every editable field is 16px or more so Safari does NOT zoom
MEASURED scale 1 to 1, scrollX 0, offsetLeft 0, doc equals clientWidth
trackKeyboard publishes --ob-kb from the VISUAL viewport
plus 44pt Safari form accessory bar, iOS only
footer switches to position fixed, lifted above the keyboard
open sheet shrinks, max-height calc 88dvh minus --ob-kb
keepFocusVisible scrolls the field into the free space

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p:
business name, text keyboard, autocorrect OFF, enterkeyhint next
GSTIN, characters, autocorrect OFF, enterkeyhint done
quantity, type number plus inputmode numeric, NUMERIC KEYPAD
quantity selects on focus so typing REPLACES, not appends
search, enterkeyhint search, autocorrect OFF

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p:
rises from the bottom, surface beneath stays visible
body scrolls independently, footer pinned, CTA always in view
padding-bottom safe-area-inset-bottom
applyScrollLock fixes body at its offset, background cannot scroll
closes on X, Cancel, Escape, backdrop tap

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p:
sheet shrinks rather than sliding under the keyboard
MEASURED scale 1 to 1, scrollX 0, doc equals clientWidth

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p:
accept unconstrained, KNOWN LIMITATION, any type accepted
Take photo uses accept image and capture environment
chosen files listed with a per-file remove control
input value reset after each pick so the same file can be re-added

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TOUCH TARGETS, all 44px or more.
Quiet controls keep their drawn size and gain an
invisible after-element expander: provenance chip,
Why this matters, back, sheet close.
Grown properly: checkbox, Select all, secondary
actions, Check, remove line, remove file, chips.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
KNOWN LIMITATION
The sheet grip suggests swipe-to-dismiss.
There is no gesture handler. X, Cancel,
Escape and backdrop are the exits.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ENVIRONMENTAL, NOT A BUILD DEFECT
Safari persists page zoom PER ORIGIN. A device that
loaded this build before the 16px fix keeps that zoom
until site data is cleared. Discriminator: it pans on
the old origin and is clean on a fresh one, same
device, same build.
